research_studies.title: Mapping the Impact of Climate Seasonality on Ageing
research_studies.abstract: Study of how climate seasonality shapes the lived experiences of older adults in Busia and Kilifi counties, Kenya, including climate-related health and wellbeing and resilience and adaptation strategies at individual, household and community levels.
